Spain's Coach Celebrates World Cup Victory, Mentions Player Dedication

Spain's coach Luis de la Fuente has dedicated the nation's second World Cup victory to his squad and coaching staff, emphasizing the players' role in the triumph. He expressed surprise at the achievement, stating he never anticipated such a success. Following the win, the coach also humorously noted that it was 'tattoo time' for defender Cucurella.
